taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

The resistivities of the five layers are 1340.2, 2148.3, 5322.7, 18475.7, and 19320.3 ohm-m.

To find the curve type, we examine each group of three consecutive layers:
1.  Layers 1-2-3: 1340.2 < 2148.3 < 5322.7 (r1 < r2 < r3) → **A**
2.  Layers 2-3-4: 2148.3 < 5322.7 < 18475.7 (r2 < r3 < r4) → **A**
3.  Layers 3-4-5: 5322.7 < 18475.7 < 19320.3 (r3 < r4 < r5) → **A**

The resulting sequence is AAA. According to the notation rules, if all letters are the same, the curve may be written as a single letter.

A
{"curve_type": "A"}
